# Go Boil the Water

> Go Boil the Water: A Partner's Guide to Supporting Home Birth is a book by Noah Jenks for husbands and partners whose wives are planning a home birth. It is a presence guide, not a medical guide: it covers how a partner can show up well before labor, during the birth, and in the golden hour after. The Kindle edition is available on Amazon and the audiobook is on Spotify; a paperback edition is coming.

The book draws on Noah's own experience (an adoption, two hospital births, and one home birth with his wife Katie) and on questionnaire responses from husbands, birth mothers, midwives, and doulas who have been through home births.

## Pages

- [The Book](https://goboilthewater.com/book/): description, full chapter outline, and frequently asked questions
- [About Noah Jenks](https://goboilthewater.com/about/): author background
- [Blog](https://goboilthewater.com/blog/): home birth stories and advice for partners
- [Share Your Story](https://goboilthewater.com/share-your-story/): questionnaires for partners, birth mothers, midwives, and doulas

- End: Conclusion: Go Boil the Water
